summary: Tested TutorConnect backend (11 tests, 7 passed) and frontend smoke. Found 2 critical backend bugs blocking the core flow: GET /api/tutors returns 500 (homepage tutor listing broken) and get_current_user never sets user['id'] which will break booking/checkout/tutor-profile endpoints for authenticated calls.

critical.issue: Returns 500 ResponseValidationError. Route excludes _id via projection ({'_id': 0}) but the TutorProfile response_model REQUIRES the field 'id'. Documents stored in DB have no 'id' field, only '_id'. Result: response validation fails with 'Field required' for 'id'. Frontend /tutors page shows 'No tutors found' as a consequence.
critical.fix_hint: Either remove response_model=List[TutorProfile], or include _id and convert it: tutors = await db.tutors.find(query).to_list(100); for t in tutors: t['id'] = str(t.pop('_id')).

critical.endpoint: get_current_user helper (affects POST /api/tutors/profile, POST /api/bookings, GET /api/bookings for student/tutor, POST /api/payments/checkout/session)
critical.issue: Helper sets user['_id'] = str(user['_id']) but never sets user['id']. Downstream endpoints reference user['id'] (e.g., booking_data with student_id=user['id'], tutor profile creation, payment user authorization). Any authenticated write will crash with KeyError. Note: GET /auth/me may also expose raw stringified _id instead of an id field for the frontend.
critical.fix_hint: In get_current_user, add: user['id'] = str(user['_id']); del user['_id'].

minor.issue: Parameter naming is confusing — it actually expects user_id (queries by 'user_id'), not the tutor profile id. Could not test cleanly since GET /api/tutors fails first.
Cookies set with secure=False even though the app is served over HTTPS via the public preview URL. samesite='lax' + secure=False works but is not ideal for production.
Uses {'id': booking_id} for find/update, but bookings are inserted without an 'id' field (only Mongo _id). This endpoint will never find a booking. Untested live but verified by code review.
Backend CORS allow_origins is locked to FRONTEND_URL, but .env CORS_ORIGINS='*' is ignored. allow_credentials=True with explicit single origin is fine — just inconsistent with the env var.

integration_issues.issue: Page renders but shows 'No tutors found' because GET /api/tutors returns 500. This blocks the entire booking funnel (cannot navigate to TutorDetail -> booking -> payment).

GET /api/auth/me called on every page load returns 401 for anonymous users (expected) — but errors are logged to console as 'Failed to load resource: 401'. Consider swallowing 401 in AuthContext to avoid console noise.

issues: Renders cleanly with good hero, categories, testimonials, FAQ. data-testids present on key elements.

action_items: FIX GET /api/tutors response: drop response_model=List[TutorProfile] OR map _id -> id before returning.
FIX get_current_user: set user['id'] = str(user['_id']) and remove _id. This unblocks tutor profile create, booking create, GET bookings filtered by user, and payment checkout session.
FIX PATCH /api/bookings/{booking_id}/status to query by _id (ObjectId) instead of 'id' field, OR persist an 'id' field on booking creation.
After fixes, re-run /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and re-test Tutors -> TutorDetail -> Booking -> Payment Checkout end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: MongoDB documents are inserted without an explicit 'id' field but multiple routes query by 'id' (PATCH booking status, find booking in payments) — this will silently fail.
Inconsistent ID handling: tutors are queried by user_id externally while bookings reference tutor_id == user_id; document this convention or unify.
server.py is 750 lines — should be split into auth/tutor/booking/payment modules for maintainability.
No input validation on PATCH booking status — any string accepted as status. Should be Enum.
Stripe webhook endpoint accepts unsigned bodies in error path; webhook signature verification depends on emergentintegrations lib — confirm it raises on invalid sig.
test_credentials: Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — student@test.com/student123, tutor@test.com/tutor123, admin@tutorconnect.com/admin123. Login verified working.
seed_data_creation: None created; existing seed data used (Sarah Johnson tutor, 3 testimonials).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers auth, tutors, testimonials, bookings, payments scaffold. After main agent fixes the two critical bugs (GET /api/tutors 500 and user['id'] missing), re-run pytest then proceed to playwright E2E for Login -> Tutors -> TutorDetail -> Booking -> PaymentCheckout (will redirect to Stripe; test polling on /payment/success route by mocking session_id).
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause #1 (GET /api/tutors 500): route uses Pydantic response_model TutorProfile which requires 'id', but query projection excludes _id ({'_id':0}) and no 'id' field exists on the document — validation fails. Reproduction: curl https://tutorconnect-25.preview.emergentagent.com/api/tutors -> 500. Mitigation: project _id and rename to id, OR drop response_model. Root cause #2 (user['id'] missing): get_current_user mutates _id to string but never aliases to 'id'; downstream code assumes 'id'. Mitigation: add user['id'] = str(user.pop('_id')) in get_current_user.
